name: LIFE-DEA bender v1
description: FLAGSHIP. LIFE-DEA (Lifecycle Interrogation for Flight Environments) bender protocol: multilayer benders (20x40 / 20x80 mm, usually encapsulated) cycled with a 2 s on / 2 s off square wave (0.25 Hz) at 2.0 kV (author decisions 2026-09-29, docs/MOTIVATION.md), fast interlude per 1e3 cycles, full staircase interlude per 2.5e4, milestone snapshot reports at 1e3 / 1e4 / 1e5, 1e6-cycle cap. At 0.25 Hz the cap is ~46 days of cycling. A specimen reaching the cap is a SUSPENSION (right-censored). Side-view deflection via the bender vision pipeline.

blocks.prompt: Enter chamber T (C) and pressure (mbar) before break-in.
